# Swagger UI distribution

Locally hosted, unmodified assets from `swagger-ui-dist` **5.34.0**, downloaded from the official npm registry:

https://registry.npmjs.org/swagger-ui-dist/-/swagger-ui-dist-5.34.0.tgz

Only the bundle, standalone preset, stylesheet, bundled third-party notices and upstream LICENSE/NOTICE are included. Swagger UI uses the Apache License 2.0. The page has no CDN dependency and does not send specifications to an external validator.

Upstream: https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui
